sources.title: 全球最大電動車品牌「心臟」 富田電機成特斯拉最老供應商
sources.locator: Headline; paragraph beginning 「越過1萬多公里太平洋海域」; section 「特斯拉跨海找夥伴 台灣電動車馬達啟動」
sources.note: The report describes 15 years of cooperation and calls 富田電機 Tesla's oldest supplier; it does not identify the comparison cohort.

sources.title: 面對「蘋果化」的特斯拉，要求供應商分散生產據點⋯⋯富田電機如何穩定獲利？
sources.locator: Opening paragraphs on cooperation since 2005 and the paragraph beginning 「目前特斯拉的訂單」
sources.note: Reports that 富田電機 remained a Tesla supplier and that Tesla orders were about 15% of 富田電機 revenue. This does not establish a supplier-tenure ranking.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches and source-page checks located dated reporting for both historical descriptions and a 2023 supplier/revenue update, but no official disclosure or defined comparison set that resolves the original undated rankings.
The ranking evidence is secondary reporting, not an issuer filing establishing customer-level sales or a defined supplier comparison cohort.
The 2023 report's approximately 15% figure is Tesla orders as a share of 富田電機 revenue; it does not establish that Tesla was the largest customer.
The original wording has no period. The evidence supports historical, dated descriptions only.
